title: Threat-map checker with the closed-gap rule
goal: A checker that validates the map rows and fails on a gap citing a closed record
acceptance: `tools/check-threat-map.mjs` and `npm run check:threat-map` (in `check:fast` and CI) fail on a row with neither a cited test nor a gap record, on a cited test file that does not exist and on a gap record that is closed
Fixtures: valid map, row without evidence, missing test file, closed gap record
Failing test committed first: each failing fixture expects exit 1 against an empty tool; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's 2 h for map and checker, with the checker first and the closed-gap rule added (N6). Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
